items.t: Fiserv Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.sum: Fiserv has significantly underperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are cautious about the stock’s prospects.

items.t: What Is Fiserv (FISV) Planning With Its Debit Networks And Clover AI?
items.sum: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) plans to migrate clients to a single debit network, preparing the other network for sale or wind-down. Management is reviewing underperforming operations across the group, with some non-core businesses earmarked for potential closure. items.t: Fiserv (FISV) Stock Looks Undervalued With Strong Excess Returns
items.sum: Fiserv has seen a sharp share price swing over the past few years, and recent news around cost savings and portfolio changes has pushed it back into the spotlight. With the stock rebounding in the short term but still carrying a weaker three year track record, the key issue for investors is whether the current price lines up with the returns the business earns on its capital. items.t: Citigroup Maintains Neutral on Fiserv, Raises Price Target to $67
items.sum: Citigroup analyst Bryan Keane maintains Fiserv (NASDAQ:FISV) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $62 to $67.

items.t: Bernstein Maintains Market Perform on Fiserv, Raises Price Target to $70
items.sum: Bernstein analyst Harshita Rawat maintains Fiserv (NASDAQ:FISV) with a Market Perform and raises the price target from $60 to $70.
